title: 第3章 当你凝视深渊深渊问你办不办卡第4章 只要富婆好三代没烦恼
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: 苏璃摸完脸，肚子很配合地叫了一声。
咕噜。
声音挺大。
年轻的身体新陈代谢快，饿得也快。
但苏璃没急着去找吃的。
他找了个背风的墙角，一屁股坐下。
屁股底下的烂泥有点凉，但他不在乎。
现在有个比饿肚子更要命的问题摆在面前。
他是黑户。
在奥伦达王国，尤其是在这种战时状态下的边境港口，没有居民证的人，地位连条野狗都不如。
野狗那是生态环境的一部分。
黑户那是行走的军功章，或者是奴隶贩子眼里的金币。
上一世，他刚穿越过来就被抓，如果有这玩意他估计直接就被放出来了。
而且不管是工作还是办什么事，几乎都要这个东西。
正规渠道办证？
苏璃脑子里过了遍流程。
除了出生的时候第一时间去办。
就需要三个拥有爵位的担保人。
五枚金币的手续费。
还得去市政厅排队填表，接受那个更年期办事员的盘问。
别说金币了，他现在兜里连个铜板都没有。
至于担保人……
这码头上只有想让他去死的监工，哪来的贵族老爷？
这条路堵死了。
那就只剩下一条路。
暗巷。
苏璃眯起眼睛，视线穿过繁忙的码头，看向城市最阴暗的角落。
上一世虽然混得惨，但毕竟混了五十年。
那是用血泪攒出来的经验包。
那些老乞丐闲得蛋疼的时候，最喜欢吹牛逼。
他们说，在灰鸥港的地下，有个叫“暗巷”的地方。
那里只要给钱，什么都能办。
别说居民证。
只要钱到位，你就是想搞个“流落在外的王子”证明，他们都能给你盖上国王的私印。
虽然有点夸张，但办个假证应该问题不大。
苏璃站起身，拍了拍屁股上的泥。
走。
但他没往大路上走。
content_en:
After Su Li touched her face, her stomach growled cooperatively.
Gulu.
The sound is quite loud.
A young body has a fast metabolism and gets hungry quickly.
But Su Li was not in a hurry to find food.
He found a corner with the wind behind him and sat down.
The mud was a little cold under his butt, but he didn't care.
Now there is a problem more serious than hunger.
He is a black man.
In the Kingdom of Orenda, especially at the border ports in this wartime state, people without resident certificates have a status worse than that of a wild dog.
Wild dogs are part of the ecological environment.
Kuroto's is a walking military medal, or a gold coin in the eyes of a slave trader.
In his last life, he was caught right after he traveled through time. If there was such a thing, he would have been released immediately.
And no matter whether it’s for work or anything else, I almost need this thing.
Apply through formal channels?
Su Li went through the process in her mind.
Except when you are born, do it as soon as possible.
Three guarantors with knighthoods are required.
A handling fee of five gold coins.
You also have to go to the city hall to queue up to fill out a form and be questioned by the menopause clerk.
Not to mention gold coins, he doesn't even have a copper in his pocket now.
As for the guarantor...
There are only overseers on this dock who want him to die. Where is the noble master?
The road is blocked.
Then there is only one way left.
Dark alley.
Su Li squinted her eyes and looked across the busy dock to the darkest corner of the city.
Although I had a miserable life in my last life, I still lived in misery for fifty years.
That is an experience pack saved with blood and tears.
When those old beggars are idle, they like to brag.
They said that there is a place called "Dark Alley" underground in Gray Gull Harbor.
As long as you give money, you can do anything there.
Don’t talk about the resident certificate.
As long as the money is in place, they can stamp you with the king's private seal if you just want to get a "living prince" certificate.
Although it's a bit exaggerated, getting a fake certificate shouldn't be a big problem.
Su Li stood up and patted the mud on her butt.
Walk.
But he didn't go to the road.
title_en: Chapter 3 When you stare into the abyss and ask you if you want to apply for a card Chapter 4 As long as the rich woman is good for three generations, there will be no worries
